book.name: MATEU
book.title: Eliywi no kuwaba lya Jesu Kilesite eli lina kun̄oliwa kwa MATEU

content: Abeleki mu Litema no Beine
Jesu sebeli otwalelela okwamba omo wikalele omubuso naku wilu nji, “Eliywaa linjili amasiku omulume sebeli ota mukwisanena abeleki mu litema lyaye.
Munyima no kulumelelana nabeleki okwabaanga etifo no baliywaa, mi sebeli waa tuma mu litema lyaye no beine oka sebeza.
Cwale sebeli ota kame ba musika amasiku enako aba ina kutenda mutanu ni tunee (09:00) mi sebeli omona anjili aimanine feela nambulwa omusebezi,
mi sebeli wamba kwa onjene nji, “Mute naanyi mu litema no beine muka sebeze, mi mbani mibi esi silukele.”
Cwale sebeli ata. Mi aba ana kuuka kame ku musika mu nako no munji eliywaa elili ba kaci no mutwi ni mangolwaa kuma 3 okoloko (15:00) sebeli otenda yongeso.
Mi aba ina kusinga okwana 5 okoloko (17:00) sebeli ouka ku musika nuukawana anjili aimanine, mi sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, ‘Iikene mwimanene bano eliywaa lyonje nambulwa esi mutenda?’
Cwale aanu sebeli amba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Kakuli kakwisa woyo ona tubi omusebezi. Mi sebeli waambela nji, ‘Mute naanyi mu litema lyange no beine muka sebeze.’

“Enako no mangolwaa aba ina kukeela, omunya litema no beine, sebeli wamba ku mwendisi no musebezi waye nji, ‘Oisane abeleki, mi waabe etituwelo too, otangise kwaa ana ingene munyima, otwale kwaa ana ingene ba weli.’
Cwale awo ana kwingena omusebezi, aba ina kukwana enako no 5 okoloko (17:00), omunjili ni munjili sebeli otambula etuwelo yaye eyi no ba liywaa.
Cwale awo ana kwingena ba weli aba ana kwiiya, kame ana ku yambuta nji kame sa biwe onene, kono nonyene sebeli abiwa kanyi akoo.
Cwale aba ana kumana okutambula, sebeli ahalala ku munya litema no beine.
Cwale aanu awo sebeli amba nji, ‘Aa ana ingene munyima, kame ana sebeze ehola imweya feela, mi nwaabi kanyi aci tuna shimbi okulema ni liywaa ni kubya kwa lyo.’
Kono omunya litema sebeli otambula omunjili no kwawo nji, ‘Mulikani, kani sikoonga, ninji kawa siku kuyupa ni mene nji mbubelekele amali no ba liywaa limweya?
Oshimbe sowe esi sikulukele mi okutele. Meene kame ni keta okuba woyo ona kwisaniwa munyima kanyi omo nina bele wene.
Kana kani sipumenenwa okutenda eso nisinga okutenda ku mali ange? Nji kame oyupa omuna kakuli kame nili ni lyoko no koloka eli liba?’
Mumukwanongeso, “Aa na munyima mba tende aa na ku lubala, mi aa na ku lubala mba tende aa na munyima.”
Jesu Yoamba Eyi no Lifu Lyaye aka no Waatu
Cwale Jesu yota ku Jelusalema, sebeli oshimbela kunyonga aiyetwa no kukwana likumi na yiili (12), mi sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji,
“Komu mone, kame tu katile ku Jelusalema, mi Omwana no munu kame sa biwe mu maata no apulisita akulu, na iyeti no mulawo mi mba mwa tulele elifu,
mi mba beekiwa mu maoko no macaba nji mu shubule, amushape ni kumu ngongotela ba sifapano, mi mba ingulwa ba liywaa no waatu.”
Oku Kumbela kwa Inawoo
Cwale mukataye Zebedeya sebeli oiya kwa Jesu na naaye ayiili no andumbana, mi sebeli akubama niku kumbela simweya kwa yonyene.
Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Iikene osaela?” Omukati sebeli wambela Jesu nji, “Oni sepise nji anange ayiili, akwikale omunjili kulyooko lyowe no silyo, omunjili kweli no simoo, mu mubuso owe.”
Kono Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Ka muyii esi mu kumbela.” Ninji kame mu twesa oku nwena mu komoki no mayando eyi ni tatelele oku nwena? Sebeli amba kwa yonyene nji, “Kame tutwesa.”

Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Luli mba mu nwene mu komoki yange, kono oku niikala kweli no silyo, simba kweli no simoo, kasa mene woyo so keta awo saniikale ku lyoko no silyo simba kweli no simoo, kono eyo eibaka niyaawo ana lukisetwe ngeeso kwa sitange.”
Cwale anjili aiyetwa aye aba ana kuyupa eyo, sebeli atinena Jacobo ni minaye.
Kono Jesu sebeli waisanena kwa yonyene ni kwamba nji, “Kame muyii nji abusi no macaba kame akwite amaata beulu yoo, mi awo ali mu itulo no kuneneba kame abusa mu kutweba.
Kono kaku fanene okwikala ngeeso mukaci kenu. Woyo yonje osinga oku tenda woyo no kuneneba mukaci kenu, atende omubika kwaanyi moonje,
mi woyo yonje osinga okutenda woyo no weli, atende omubika kwaanyi,
kanyi Omwana no munu kasiiya nji abelekelwe, kono abelekele aanu, ni kuba omooyo waye nji aanu no kupula aliululwe.”
Jesu aba ana Kubalisa Eibofu Yiili
Ababo Jesu na iyetwa aye aatunda mu Jeliko, aanu no kupula-pula sebeli amu kon̄a.
Eibofu yiili kame ina kwikalanga kunyonga no ndila. Aba ina kuyupa nji Jesu kame abita, sebeli ikuwa nji, “Mbumu, mwana Dabida, otu yupele amakeke!.”
Ano kupula sebeli aayuta nji aondoke, kono onyene sebeli aekeza okukuwa nji, “Mbumu, Mwana Dabida, otu yupele amakeke!”
Jesu sebeli oimana, nikwaisana, mi sebeli waibanguta nji, “Siikene musaela nji nimi tendele?”
Eibofu sebeli itambula Jesu nji, “Mbumu amiyo etu amone!”
Jesu sebeli waa yupela amakeke ni kwalema ba miyo oo. Mi mu wangu-wangu sebeli amona niku mukon̄a.
